### What is missing
The buyers of Kazakhstan's uranium output are not in our sources. A source that would settle it: offtake and supply agreements disclosed in the producers' annual reports and filings, customs and trade records (UN Comtrade), and the buyers' own procurement disclosures.

Outside the corpus — foreign joint venture partners typically secure offtake shares matching their equity ownership to feed conversion and fuel fabrication facilities serving nuclear utilities in their respective domestic and export markets.
